versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release for Donation Drop-off Planner.

- Helps users sort, label, pack, and plan donation drop-offs for household goods.
- Groups items by condition (ready, clean/repair, check rules, do not donate, recycle/dispose).
- Suggests likely destination types based on item categories, without guaranteeing acceptance.
- Provides ready-to-use bag and box labels, a packing checklist, and a drop-off checklist.
- Flags unsafe or unsuitable items as “Do Not Donate” or “Verify First”.
- Clearly states no tax valuation or tax advice is provided.
